purpose: Define tool results as inert execution evidence with exact invocation/execution/tool provenance, classification and failure/partial status.

topics.name: Tool Result Evidence
topics.purpose: Define tool results as inert execution evidence with exact invocation/execution/tool provenance, classification and failure/partial status.

semantics.identity_rule: Each material tool result has explicit identity.
semantics.request_rule: Result references exact tool invocation request/execution.
semantics.classification_rule: Result may inherit classification/lineage from accessed sources.
semantics.secondary_rule: Result cannot silently trigger secondary operations.
semantics.authority_rule: Tool output contents grant no downstream authority.

invariants.rule: Command, Routine, Trigger, Schedule, Tool and model definitions remain separate from invocations, requests, executions and results; definitions never create effects merely by existing.
Automated work still resolves exact operation/target/context and must cross validation, authorization and dispatcher boundaries before any effect occurs.

hard_gates.condition: tool result calls another tool automatically

references.purpose: Results stay inert across tool boundary.
